methodologyNotes: Nine models covering top-searched premium and mid-range US hair straighteners. Specs and prices re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer product pages (dyson.com, chi.com, bioionic.com, ghdhair.com, babylisspro.com), official retailer pages (Ulta, Nordstrom, Dermstore, ProStylingTools), and product listings. All temperatures in Fahrenheit; plate_width_in is nominal styling plate width in decimal inches; heat_settings is the count of discrete settings (null when only a continuous/digital dial is confirmed); cordless, dual_voltage and auto_shutoff are boolean. Adversarial pass corrected: BaBylissPRO MSRP (manufacturer price), CHI auto_shutoff (analog model has none), and ghd Gold release year (nulled as unverifiable). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Dyson Corrale
products.priceNote: MSRP, dyson.com product page
products.provenance: Price $539.99 confirmed directly on the dyson.com Corrale product page (a general web search snippet quoted $649.99, but the live product page shows $539.99). Three heat settings (330/365/410°F), max 410°F, cordless up to ~30 min, dual voltage, and flexing manganese-copper-alloy plates all confirmed on the same page. Auto shut-off (10 min inactivity) per Dyson manual. Release 2020 per Dyson press materials. Plate width ~1.0 in is the widely cited nominal figure (Dyson lists device dimensions, not a discrete plate-face inch value).

products.name: ghd Platinum+

products.provenance: $279 confirmed at multiple US retailers (Nordstrom, Amazon, ghdhair.com); Sephora $289 / Bluemercury $319 show normal variance. Plate material is ceramic-coated aluminum per ghd. Source URL switched to the official ghd product page.

products.name: Dyson Airstrait Straightener
products.priceNote: priceUsd nulled on re-verification (2026-07-08): the dyson.com Airstrait page is currently out of stock ("Sorry, this product is currently out of stock. Please leave us your email address...") and displays no product price — no "$499.99", "Was $499.99", "current price: $399.99", or "Save $100.00" appears anywhere in the fetched text (the only $ figures are shipping thresholds: $50, $49.99, $4.99). Amazon shows "No featured offers available" with no listed price (only a customer review opines a "$200-250 range"). The prior $499.99/$399.99 MSRP-and-promo claim could not be corroborated verbatim from either fetched source.
products.provenance: Re-verified 2026-07-08 against freshly fetched source and corroboration text. dyson.com Airstrait page confirms auto shut-off behavior (FAQ: enters auto-standby after five minutes of inactivity when arms are open, or three minutes if locked; the LCD turns off and you must press the power button to restart) → auto_shutoff=true, and single-region/single-voltage operation ("Your straightener has been precisely engineered for styling at the voltage of the country in which it was purchased"; "should only be used in the region it was purchased") → dual_voltage=false. The Dyson page is out of stock and shows NO price, so priceUsd was nulled (no "$499.99"/"Was $499.99"/"$399.99"/"Save $100.00" present; only shipping thresholds $50/$49.99/$4.99). Amazon "From the manufacturer" confirms the temperature presets — wet mode "175°F, 230°F, and 285°F" and dry mode "250°F or 285°F" (highest numeric temperature 285°F → max_temp_f=285; Boost mode is unquantified); the "Compare with similar items" table lists the Airstrait column's heat settings as "3 heat" → heat_settings=3; and product info confirms corded single-voltage operation ("Product voltage: 100 ... compatible with outlets that support 100 volts and might require a converter when used outside of the United States") plus a customer-referenced power cord ("the cord that comes with this is a beast") → cordless=false. plate_material and plate_width_in remain null because the Airstrait uses high-pressure airflow with "No hot plates" — there is no plate to spec. releaseDate/release nulled: no fetched page states an explicit launch year (an August 2023 owner-survey date is referenced, but that is a survey date, not a stated release date). Model confirmed exact: Amazon lists model number 143280-01 / ASIN B0F96Q7BP3 (matches corroboration URL); both pages are the Dyson Airstrait straightener (not a sibling/variant), so publish=true.
